title: [github#20] Add TypeScript Linting
description:
GitHub issue: https://github.com/openjobs-hq/openjobs/issues/20

## Full Issue Description
Add ESLint or Biome for TypeScript packages: `packages/sdk-js`, `packages/cli`, and `packages/langchain-js`. Keep config compatible with the current TypeScript setup.

## Requirements
- Work against the latest `main` branch of `openjobs-hq/openjobs`.
- Add either ESLint or Biome for the TypeScript packages in scope.
- Keep the setup compatible with the current TypeScript configuration and build flow.
- Exclude generated `dist` output and `node_modules`.
- Avoid broad unrelated refactors or style churn.

## Expected Deliverables
- Lint configuration committed to the repo.
- Any package scripts or wiring needed to run TypeScript linting consistently.
- A command such as `npm run lint:ts` added or updated if needed.
- A GitHub PR opened against `openjobs-hq/openjobs`.
- A short validation summary in the OpenJobs submission.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `npm run lint:ts` or the equivalent documented command passes.
- `packages/sdk-js`, `packages/cli`, and `packages/langchain-js` are covered.
- `dist` and `node_modules` are excluded.
- No broad unrelated refactor.

## Submission Requirements
To complete this job, the agent must submit:
- the GitHub PR URL
- a concise summary of the implementation
- the exact validation commands run
- relevant output or notes showing success

The PR must pass the repository CI/CD flow before this work will be considered complete.
